# DeepSeek Harness Handbook

> An independent, source-backed, agent-first field guide to the official DeepSeek Harness runtime.

Canonical site: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/
Canonical content: https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/tree/main/docs/en
Language status: English canonical; Simplified Chinese partial and reviewed; Japanese, Korean, and Spanish navigation drafts.
Atom updates feed: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/feed.xml
Source repository: https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook
Official upstream runtime: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness

## Start here

- [Build your first DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/first-deepseek-harness-plugin.html): Load a local TypeScript module, register a typed Agent tool, package an installable bundle, inspect the profile composition, and remove it cleanly.
- [Custom plugin Session event compatibility](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/custom-session-events.html): Choose plugin storage by reconstruction semantics, preserve strict unknown-event refusal, and test cold resume with and without the plugin across Harness versions.
- [Fix the HMR expose-internals startup error](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/hmr-expose-internals.html): Route source, npx, and global-install topologies; verify the pinned pnpm; probe helper resolution; and use the direct Node flag only as a disposable diagnostic.
- [Code Mode worker-thread trust boundary](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/code-mode-security-boundary.html): Separate worker reliability containment from enforceable OS isolation, inspect exposure without an escape proof, and choose native tools or a constrained outer boundary.
- [Fix ReplaceFileW EACCES on Windows](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/windows-replacefile-eacces.html): Distinguish an HMR watcher conflict from ACL denial, then stop, back up, edit, validate, restart, and roll back without exposing partial YAML.
- [Diagnose slow TTFT](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/slow-ttft.html): Split time-to-first-token into Host outbound, provider, and Host inbound intervals, then test mature Session event volume and concurrent model steps independently.
- [Recover a poisoned Session](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/poisoned-session-recovery.html): Diagnose recurring `400 INVALID_REQUEST` after truncated tool-call JSON, export the durable evidence, and recover without editing a live compressed log.
- [Stop a runaway Agent loop](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/runaway-agent-loop.html): Cancel the active turn, prove provider calls stopped, distinguish Agent loops from retry storms, and add an independent spending boundary before retrying.
- [Protect live session logs](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/session-log-durability.html): Stop the writer before backup or repair, then separate missing paths, sequence gaps, torn tails, and tool-call identity corruption.
- [Fix a missing /bin/bash](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/pty-shell-path.html): Configure the terminal-bash preset row with the exact executable path on NixOS, containers, and other non-FHS hosts.
- [Connect local Ollama](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/ollama-local-provider.html): Configure the custom-provider form, prove reachability from the Harness host, and diagnose container localhost failures.
- [Bound subagent scale](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/subagent-scale-oom.html): Separate concurrency from total-agent limits and turn large fan-out jobs into measured, restartable batches.
- [Plugin installation and recovery](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/plugin-recovery.html): Preserve a known-good profile, inspect bundle reconciliation, and route the first composition error.
- [Version evidence](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/version-evidence.html): Separate moving npm dist-tags, immutable published artifacts, the installed executable, and the source revision before reporting a failure.
- [Official DeepSeek Harness identity](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/official-deepseek-harness.html): Verify the DeepSeek AI repository, scoped npm package, rc.7 release commit, executable, and independent handbook boundary before installing.
- [DeepSeek Harness rc.7 field status](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/field-status.html): Current high-signal boundaries for installation, sessions, sandboxing, remote Web, Windows paths, and MCP configuration, with primary evidence and safer next actions.
- [Interactive failure router](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/diagnose.html): Pick the first broken boundary and get the first evidence, command, success signal, and focused guide.
- [What is DeepSeek Harness?](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/what-is-deepseek-harness.md): Separate the model, provider API, runtime, profile, tools, policy, and session layers.
- [Five-minute Web quickstart](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/getting-started/quickstart.md): Run a bounded first task and inspect the resolved runtime graph.
- [Headless Agent](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/getting-started/headless-agent.md): Operate one non-interactive task with explicit artifacts and exit evidence.
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/getting-started/python-sdk.md): Embed the runtime over its JSON-RPC lifecycle.
- [MCP integration](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/integrations/mcp.md): Diagnose process, transport, handshake, registration, and policy separately.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/README.md): Route symptoms to the provider, loop, tool, policy, sandbox, or session layer.
- [Subagent route inheritance incident note](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/subagent-route-inheritance.html): Diagnose and mitigate child agents using a stale provider route or unexpected credential.
- [Remote Web secure-context incident note](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/remote-web-secure-context.html): Diagnose empty workspaces and providers caused by crypto.randomUUID failures over plain HTTP.
- [Operator cheat sheet](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/reference/cheat-sheet.md): Commands, evidence checks, and production boundaries.

## Download

- [DeepSeek Harness Field Guide v0.1.0](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/releases/download/v0.1.0/DeepSeek-Harness-Field-Guide-v0.1.0.pdf): Ten-page visual PDF for onboarding and offline reference.

## Project boundary

This is a community-maintained handbook from SandBase, not an official DeepSeek AI project. Version-sensitive claims link to primary sources and record verification dates.
- [Fix pnpm global native-binding resolution](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/pnpm-global-native-binding.html): Preserve the isolated store, trace the helper from its physical owner, and compare an exact project-local install before changing dependency visibility.
- [Fix macOS workspace picker paths](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/macos-workspace-picker.html): Distinguish valid spaces from a leaked terminal HFS colon, preserve realpath identity, and test the picker plus registry boundary.
